title: trike
tagline: A social media dApp built on Lens Protocol, leveraging social graphs
description: This project is a web3 social media built on Lens Protocol. It uses social graphs of lens. Unlike traditional social media, Lens protocol uses open data concept. This project leverages the data base of Lens Protocol. This project uses Lens API. I used apollo client to fetch GraphQL API of Lens protocol. I chose to deploy on polygon testnet because of faster transaction speed and lower gas fees.
how_its_made: This project is built on Lens Protocol and leverages it's open data base of users. This project is deployed on polygon mumbai testnet because of the faster transaction time and low gas cost. I used React.js to build modern UI components and uses GraphQL to fetch the Lens Protocol database API.
